parameters.content:
## BookLeaf job status
GET /webhook/royalty-summary/jobs?ids=<id>,<id>[&include=html] with header X-BookLeaf-Key (n8n Header Auth). Up to 50 ids; unknown ids come back in `missing`. Successful runs are not saved (Bubble polls every few seconds).

## Answer
The jobs, in the order asked; 503 if the database is down.

parameters.query:
SELECT job_id::text AS job_id, log_id, batch_id, author_id, author_code, mode, status, error_code, error,
  subject, sent_to, figures_verified, ai_attempts, provider, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd::float8 AS cost_usd,
  requested_by, created_at, updated_at, completed_at, callback_status,
  stage, stage_at, delivery, tone, length, issues, edit_text, drafted_at,
  CASE WHEN ($1::jsonb->>'include_html')::boolean THEN html END AS html,
  CASE WHEN ($1::jsonb->>'include_html')::boolean THEN text_body END AS text_body
FROM royalty_jobs
WHERE job_id = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb->'ids'))::uuid[])

parameters.responseBody: {"error":{"code":"DB_UNAVAILABLE","message":"The job database could not be reached, so the request was not handled. Try again shortly.","retryable":true}}
